digest.component_or_area: reconciler, runner, and operation snapshot architecture
propositions: Reconciler Mutation uses generic Mapping[str,Any] payload and polymorphic legacy dispatch; must converge to one typed discriminated-union contract by (direction,action) and delete translation paths

PydanticAIRunner.run() has fragmented ownership across ProviderSession, model_classes, structured_run, agent_call, runner_support, and capability modules; must reshape seams to preserve existing lifecycle/telemetry boundaries and ADR 0058's 800-LOC ceiling without adding new headroom gates

OperationSnapshot is authoritative at reconciler runtime but CLI/shared-command/LLM-operation paths independently call emit_shadow_snapshot() and resolve LLMConfig.from_env(); must compose once and thread projection through all boundaries to eliminate ambient re-reads

Portable shadow corpus and ephemeral Jira DC differential tests must prove parity between legacy and typed reconciler routes before cutover and deletion of polymorphic apply, duplicate CREATE shapes, and legacy dispatch

Runner lifecycle research must record current effect/fault matrix and ADR disposition to ground refactoring within proven seams; no function-NLOC ratchet or per-file headroom machinery may be introduced

Module-size headroom extractions (run_differs.py, outbound_differ.py, applier.py, llm/config.py, plan_review/__init__.py) must land before typed-payload and runner-refactor work touches the same files
